Basic arithmetic operations are supported:

```
>>> 3 + 2
5
>>> 3 * (2 + 3)
15
```

All numbers are integers, unbounded in both directions:
```
>>> 394902839048903284092380948239084098
394902839048903284092380948239084098
>>> -3984098239048902384908230948390284902384098
-3984098239048902384908230948390284902384098
```
